R452.note: Adds secure: true to the existing res.cookie options; nothing else in the handler changes.

R453.note: Constant Jinja2 template with label/status passed as variables so autoescaping applies; same HTML structure, Markup wrapper and import dropped, no behaviour change for non-HTML labels.

R454.note: Pins ValidAlgorithms to HS256 as the case comment calls for; the write-up states the HS256 assumption plainly, though it would need to match whatever the issuer actually signs with.

R455.note: Rejects field_index >= MAX_FIELDS with the existing -1 error path before the array read; indices 4..15 (zeroed but in-bounds) still resolve as before.

R456.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare returns 1 only on equal length and content, meeting the exact-equality contract; empty-header guard preserved.

R457.note: URI.isAbsolute() rejects scheme-bearing URLs but a protocol-relative value like //evil.com/x has no scheme, passes the check, and Tomcat's sendRedirect resolves it to the external host; the relative-only restriction is the stated fix for an open redirect.

R458.note: archive/tar removes the shell entirely, but the fix silently drops the request context the contract says must still drive cancellation and cannot read gzip/bz2/xz tarballs that tar -tf auto-detects, so those legitimate listings now 500 while the write-up claims output matches the original.

R459.note: shared_ptr ownership removes the dangling pointer and keeps subscription order; the subscribe() signature change and lifetime extension are stated in the write-up (weak_ptr would be the more conventional observer shape but this is workable).

R460.note: redis-py hset sends length-prefixed RESP so CRLF in the value cannot start a new command; new dependency and library swap are stated, and Redis errors now surface as exceptions where the fire-and-forget original ignored them, which affects no legitimate write.

R461.note: Unseeded SecureRandom replaces the caller-seeded Random; the now-unused seed parse is left in place so request handling (including the NumberFormatException on a missing seed) is unchanged.

R462.note: 128 bits from SecureRandom, base64url without padding; the cookie value format change is stated and the value is only compared against the session copy, so nothing legitimate breaks.

R463.note: Argument list closes shell injection and the stdout/stderr redirection to the log file reproduces the > and 2>&1 semantics; a leading-dash host could still reach ping as a flag, so a -- separator would have been tighter.

R464.note: self.get_object() applies the owner-scoped queryset (404 for another user's invoice, staff see all) and runs IsInvoiceOwner; response body unchanged, leftover get_object_or_404 import is harmless.

R465.note: Build FAIL: Order has customerUsername, not getUserId(), and CustomUserDetails does not exist in the case, so the service no longer compiles and the endpoint stops working for everyone; the ownership check should have compared order.getCustomerUsername() to auth.getName().

R466.note: sqlite3 ? placeholder with (term,) parameter preserves the exact-match query; client-side escaping left alone as the contract directs.
